failureClassification.cause: page.reload() fired 16 ms before a post-save getRecordChoicesAction server action; WebKit cancelled it and reported the framework (Next.js fetchServerAction) rejection as a page error. The application caller already handles failures.
Playwright request context reused an idle socket (~6.0 s after the previous response) as the e2e server closed it at Node's 5 s keepAliveTimeout: socket hang up. Server process unchanged and healthy.

Playwright WebKit (WPE) content-process segfault in ThreadedCompositor: three kernel-logged NULL reads at the identical libWPEWebKit-2.0.so offset 0x5898f8a, matching three observer Page:crash events, all while Configure drawers/menus animate. Reported attribution: WebKit bug 323720 (fixed upstream 361bf1bd5a, not in Playwright webkit-2359), triggered by tw-animate-css overlay keyframes animating filter: blur(0); real Safari is very likely unaffected. Not masked; no filter widened. A keyframe override is being integrated separately.
